content: Aɣelleb x tendint n Rabba n Ɛammun

Ɣar uqeṭṭu n useggʷas n jdid, di řweqt i dd itteffɣen ijeǧiden ɣar umenɣi, imsar aqa Yuwab igewwed jjehd n řɛeskar. Yareddeǧ tammurt n ayt n Ɛammun uca inneḍ i Rabba, iḥṣar i-tt, umi iqqim Dawud di Urcalim. Yuwab iɣřeb x Rabba uca iteḥḥa i-tt.

Dawud ikkes ttaj n ujeǧid x uzeǧif nnes, u netta yufa řewzen nnes d ict n talint n wureɣ. Tuɣa xas tayaqutin iɣřan. Ssarsen ttaj nni x uzeǧif n Dawud. Netta yiwi-dd ɛawed takeccaḍt d tameqqrant aṭṭas zi tendint.

Řgens nni iǧan di tendint issuffeɣ i-t uca ihjem xasen s řmencarat d iyařzimen n wuzzař d ccwaqar n wuzzař. Ammu i igga Dawud ak-d marra tineddam n ayt n Ɛammun. Xenni iɛqeb Dawud d marra řgens ɣar Urcalim.
Awarni as imsar, aqa ikkar ɛawed umenɣi ak-d Ifilisṭiniyyen di Jazar. Řexdenni iɣřeb Sabkay, Aḥucayi, x Saffay, wenni d ijj zeg warrawen n Rafa, uca ttwasswaḍɛen nitni.
Tuɣa din ɛawed amenɣi ak-d Ifilisṭiniyyen. Ilḥanan, mmis n Yaɛir, iɣřeb x Laḥmi, umas n Juliyat, zi Jat. Akeccuḍ n lansa nnes igga am yijj n weɛmud n ukeccuḍ n uxeyyeḍ.
Uca ikkar ɛawed umenɣi di Jat. Tuɣa din ijj n weryaz d azirar s setta n iḍewḍan deg ifassen nnes u setta n tfednin deg iḍaren nnes, marra řqedd nsen arebɛa u-ɛicrin. Uřa d netta ittwaxřeq-dd i Rafa.
Netta istehza zi Israil, maca Yunatan, mmis n Cimɛa, umas n Dawud, iɣřeb xas.
Ina d inni ittwaxeřqen-dd i Rafa di Jat u nitni wḍan s ufus n Dawud u s ufus n imsexxaren nnes.
